name: OpenVibe.Games

site.name: Games
site.what: Scraplandia, a shared pixel canvas and other games that run in a tab and know your OpenVibe account.

notes: Scraplandia (browser runtime). Players are keyed by canonical Network subjects (ADR-0006 in the repo). Calls Events (events.event.publish), Media (media.object.upload, namespace games: map-editor assets) and Network identity (identity.subject.resolve, batch legacy adoption) with the games client-credentials principal. Mods: games-content@1 declarative packs only; executable mods wait for OpenVibe.Host Stage C. No achievement system exists, so there are no games.achievement.* events.
